caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with its lid open, revealing the interior. The chest is rectangular with a compartment inside on the right side. The inner side of the lid and the exterior panels of the chest are decorated with floral patterns. On the lid’s inner surface, there are yellow, red, and pink flowers with stylized green leaves. The front and side panels of the chest feature large blue, pink, and red flowers with green leaves, arranged symmetrically. There is a central vertical decorative element on the front panel, consisting of yellow and red geometric shapes. The primary background color of the chest’s exterior is a dark blue or black, with the floral patterns painted in vivid, contrasting colors. The frame and edges of the chest are bordered with a light beige or ivory color. The feet of the chest are also decorated with painted details. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige, and the artist's name, “ROY MOON,” is inscribed in light gray in the lower right section of the drawing.
title: Painted Wooden Chest or Casket
